card.title: THUNDERBOLT
card.text: Deployment: Draw 2 cards. Then choose a card in hand and put it on top of your deck.
card.flavorText: After its activation in 1917, the 83rd Infantry Division saw limited action in WWI, but it would earn lasting recognition during WWII. Nicknamed the “Thunderbolt” Division, it landed at Omaha Beach in June 1944, a few weeks after D-Day, and quickly proved its mettle during the Allied breakout from Normandy. The 83rd advanced rapidly through France and into Luxembourg, often engaging in bitter combat. It gained a reputation for aggressiveness, especially during operations in the Normandy bocage and during the drive toward the German border. In late 1944, it took part in the Battle of the Bulge, helping blunt the German offensive. In 244 days of combat, the Thunderbolt Division liberated over 80,000 square kilometers and captured more than 150,000 prisoners. The division fought through Germany and was among the first American units to reach the Elbe River. There, they famously linked up with Soviet forces, marking a key moment in the final collapse of Nazi Germany.
